primaryNotice: Two bases: Kotor (Oct 1, 4, 5) and Žabljak (Oct 2, 3). The adjusted daily driving ceiling is 5.5 hours, including a +20% mountain-terrain allowance. P14 over Sedlo is the featured Day 3 out-and-back; conservative planning is about 5.4 adjusted hours with only the Plužine/Piva viewpoint stop. Public estimates vary, so confirm the complete live route with waypoints before departure and trim any extra stop if it exceeds 5.5 hours. Finish high-altitude driving by 16:00. Skip P14 for snow, ice, poor visibility, a closure, or unsafe road conditions. Tara Bridge is closed through Oct 26, 2026 at noon and is excluded.
fallbackNotice: Use this branch if P14/Sedlo or the northern transfer is unsafe, closed, or over the 5.5-hour adjusted daily ceiling. Kotor remains the base for all five nights; Days 3–5 cover Lovćen/Cetinje, Lake Skadar, and the Bay. No high alpine roads are used.

days.drive: TIV → M-11 → Lepetane ferry → Kamenari → M-1 via Herceg Novi / Lipci / Risan → Kotor · scenic loop allow 1.5–2 h; direct road 20–30 min
days.morning: Land at TIV at 13:50. Collect the estate car, test-load both checked cases and both cabin trolleys under the closed parcel shelf, photograph existing damage, and get the roadside number before you leave. Plan wheels rolling around 15:15–15:30.
days.afternoon: Go straight to your Kotor hotel without stopping on the way. For the scenic bay loop, take M-11 from Tivat to Lepetane, cross to Kamenari, then follow M-1 west via Herceg Novi and Lipci before continuing around the north shore through Risan to Kotor. The published summer timetable runs every 15–20 minutes through Oct 11; the Oct small-car fare is €4 off-season. This is the long scenic way, not a shortcut; use the direct Tivat–Kotor road through the Vrmac tunnel if you just want to get to the hotel. Stay with the car at the ferry and do not stop for a viewpoint or swim until all four bags are unloaded.
days.evening: Once the bags are inside, walk Kotor Old Town for dinner. Skip the car trip into the old center: traffic pinches down and parking is the trap. If you arrive late, eat near the hotel and save the walls for another day.
days.parking: Unpack at the Kotor lodging first. If you visit the Old Town, use the reserved hotel space or signed edge-of-town parking; do not circle the center.
days.cash: Keep €4 ready if you take the ferry; the Oct fare is off-season. Carry small notes for roadside purchases.
days.heading: Day 1 - Tivat → Kotor / Bay ferry option / Old Town

days.drive: Kotor → Nikšić → Šavnik → Žabljak · cited 3 h 04, about 3 h 41 adjusted
days.morning: Eat early and leave Kotor by 07:00. Follow M-1 along the bay toward Lipci, M-8 via Grahovo to Vilusi, M-7 to Nikšić, M-3 to Jasenovo Polje, then M-6 through Šavnik to Žabljak. Budget about 3 h 04 before the terrain allowance, roughly 3 h 41 adjusted, plus breaks. M-8 and the Šavnik bends are slow; do not plan a tight lunch booking.
days.afternoon: Drive straight to the Žabljak lodging. Arrange early check-in or guarded luggage storage; unload all four bags before going anywhere. If there is still daylight and the weather is decent, do the short Black Lake shore loop and turn around when the light or footing starts to go. Do not start a long mountain hike today.
days.evening: Eat in Žabljak and ask the host which places are actually open in October. Keep the car parked at the lodging overnight.
days.parking: Ask for early check-in or guarded bag storage before leaving Kotor. Unload at Žabljak before Black Lake; keep the car empty.
days.cash: Durmitor entry is listed at €5/person/day. Three planned park days (Black Lake, P14, Skadar) total €15/person; the 2026 all-parks pass is €13.50/person, if the separate entries are all charged.
days.heading: Day 2 - Kotor → Žabljak / M8–M7–M6 / Black Lake

days.drive: Žabljak → P14/Sedlo → Trsa → Plužine/Piva viewpoint → return · plan 4 h 30 wheel time / 5 h 24 adjusted; LIVE ROUTE GATE REQUIRED
days.morning: Make this your P14 day. Start around 07:30 after checking AMSCG, the forecast and your lodging host for the Sedlo pass. Enter P-14 only if it is open, dry enough, and clear of ice or low cloud. Put Žabljak → Trsa → Plužine/Piva viewpoint → Žabljak into Google Maps before leaving; the whole out-and-back is provisionally 4 h 30 behind the wheel, or 5 h 24 after +20%. Go only if the live total is at most 5 h 30.
days.afternoon: Stay on P-14 over Sedlo (about 1,911 m). It is paved, narrow and winding, with two-way traffic and few comfortable passing places; use signed pullouts and expect to reverse to a passing place. Give the drive about 2 h 15 each way, plus photo/lunch stops. Stop at the Plužine/Piva viewpoint and lakeside, then turn around. Skip Mratinje Dam and the cheese-farm detour unless Maps still shows ≤5 h 30 adjusted and a Žabljak return by 16:00. If the core loop itself breaks the cap, switch to the coast fallback; do not pretend the timing works.
days.evening: Get back to Žabljak before dark and have dinner nearby. Do not tack on the seven-hour Jablan Lake circular hike; if P14 is cancelled, use the short Bosača out-and-back as a separate, time-boxed alternative.
days.parking: Start and finish at Žabljak with luggage secured. Use signed pullouts; never stop on blind bends. Download the road map and Maps.me trail data offline.
days.cash: Budget €5/person for the Durmitor day ticket if charged; the €13.50/person 2026 annual pass can cover the three planned park days. Keep small notes for village food.
days.heading: Day 3 - Žabljak → P14 / Sedlo → Trsa → Plužine / Piva Lake

days.drive: Žabljak → Šavnik → Nikšić → Kotor · route estimates vary; 3 h 04 cited, 3 h 41 adjusted
days.morning: Leave Žabljak by 07:00. Retrace M-6 via Šavnik to Jasenovo Polje, M-3 to Nikšić, M-7 to Vilusi, M-8 through Grahovo to Lipci, then M-1 to Kotor. Allow about 3 h 04 before the +20% terrain buffer, around 3 h 41 adjusted, and more if you stop. Check road/weather notices before rolling; never route across Đurđevića Tara Bridge, which is closed through Oct 26 at noon.
days.afternoon: Go directly to the Kotor lodging, unload, and park. Do not add Perast or a viewpoint while the bags are in the car. Once checked in, take a short walk or rest; after two mountain days, a packed attraction list is a bad trade.
days.evening: Book dinner inside the Old Town or near the hotel and leave the car put. For the historic core, walk in from a marked lot instead of circling the narrow streets.
days.parking: Go directly to Kotor lodging, unload and park. Explore the Old Town on foot; use a signed public lot if the hotel space is full.
days.cash: Keep €20 for fuel or toll contingencies. The planned M-6/M-7/M-8 return avoids Sozina and the A1.
days.heading: Day 4 - Žabljak → Kotor / M6–M7–M8–M1

days.drive: Kotor ↔ Virpazar · about 1 h 12 each way; 2 h 53 adjusted round trip
days.morning: Choose one outing; do not try to cram all three into the last full day. For Skadar, leave Kotor around 08:00 for Virpazar. The scenic route uses R-1 toward Njeguši/Cetinje, then R-15; the coastal option is M-1 through Budva and Petrovac, M-1.1 through the tolled Sozina Tunnel, then M-2/R-15. Follow live routing around works and weather. Book a boat only after the operator confirms an October departure and return time. The park lists €5/person/day and says one cruise is included; verify that it covers your chosen trip. Old €10 group / €50 private fares are traveler history, not quotes.
days.afternoon: On the Skadar option, be ashore by 15:45, eat in Virpazar, and add a Godinje winery only if you have a reservation and a sober driver. Perast is the lighter alternative: park at the signed lot, walk the lanes, and take the island boat only if it is running. Budva/Sveti Stefan is the beach-and-old-town alternative; traffic and parking can eat the afternoon, and Budva itself is easy to skip if crowds annoy you. Return to Kotor before dark.
days.evening: Have the final dinner in Kotor. Leave bags at the hotel and keep tomorrow’s airport run boring and predictable.
days.parking: Leave bags at the Kotor hotel. Use marked lots in Virpazar, Perast or Budva; do not leave valuables in the car.
days.cash: Carry €20–40/person for the chosen outing. Three park days at €5 each cost €15/person; the 2026 all-parks annual pass is €13.50/person, if all three admissions are required.
stops: Our Lady of the Rocks pier
days.heading: Day 5 - Kotor base / Lake Skadar OR Perast OR Budva

days.drive: Kotor → TIV · about 10–15 min; airport 7.7 km
days.morning: Have breakfast at 08:30 and leave Kotor by 09:30. Take the direct road to TIV; do not detour for a last viewpoint. Refuel only if your contract requires it, photograph the fuel gauge and car condition, and return the car by 11:30.
days.afternoon: Walk to the terminal and be inside by 12:15 for the required counter check-in. The flight leaves at 14:55, but rental inspection queues and airport procedures are not the place to gamble.
days.parking: No sightseeing stops. Return the car by 11:30 and keep rental paperwork and deposit details handy.
days.cash: Keep a payment card accessible; only refuel if your contract requires a full tank.
days.heading: Day 6 - Kotor → TIV / rental return / flight home

checks.name: Mandatory Durmitor / northern highlands
checks.detail: Day 3 traverses P14/Sedlo and reaches Plužine/Piva; Tara Bridge and rafting are excluded.

checks.name: Two-base star-trip lodging
checks.detail: Kotor nights 1, 4 and 5; Žabljak nights 2 and 3. Two hotel changes.

checks.name: Daily adjusted driving ≤5.5 h
checks.detail: Transfer days are about 3 h 41 adjusted from cited 3 h 04 route times. P14 is provisionally budgeted at 5 h 24 adjusted (4 h 30 wheel time), but route estimates vary. Check all waypoints on the day; remove optional spurs first. If the core P14 loop exceeds 5.5 h, it fails and must not be labelled compliant.

checks.name: P14 daylight and weather gate
checks.detail: Start by 07:45 only after same-day road and weather checks; return to Žabljak and finish high-altitude driving by 16:00. Skip for snow, ice, poor visibility, closure or unsafe conditions.

checks.name: Luggage concealment
checks.detail: Day 1 ferry/road goes directly to Kotor lodging; Day 2 goes directly to Žabljak lodging. Check in or confirm guarded luggage storage before excursions; no bags remain exposed in a parked vehicle.

checks.name: Day 6 airport radius and terminal by 12:15
checks.detail: Kotor–TIV is within 30 minutes under normal traffic; car return by 11:30, terminal by 12:15.

checks.name: Tara bridge closure avoided
checks.detail: Official closure extends through Oct 26, 2026 at noon; neither branch depends on crossing it. Rafting is omitted unless an operator confirms safe independent access.

crucialGroundTips: Book a midsize estate or larger by exact model. Test all four bags under the closed parcel cover before signing; liters on a rental listing do not prove fit.

Pay for low-excess SCDW and get glass, tires/wheels, underbody, gravel and roadside cover in writing. Confirm P-14 is allowed by the rental contract; keep the spare/repair kit and assistance number accessible.

Use Google Maps for road routing, then add at least 20% for switchbacks and another 30–60 minutes for stops, traffic or roadworks. The P14 number has only six minutes of ceiling margin; the live route decides.
Download offline Google Maps for the road corridor and Maps.me for marked trails before leaving Wi-Fi. Trail markings are patchy in Google Maps; do not count on mobile signal in Durmitor.
Fill the tank before the P14 day. The tourism guide notes there are no gas stations on the Plužine–Žabljak protected section. Carry water, warm layers, snacks and a charged power bank.
Expect narrow two-way roads, rockfall, potholes, unprotected edges and occasional tire trouble. Slow down, leave room for oncoming buses, and stop only at visible signed pullouts.
Check in and unload before exploring. Never leave the four bags exposed in a parked car. In Kotor, reserve lodging with parking or use a marked lot at the edge of the Old Town.

Keep €50–100 in small cash notes for park booths and rural stops. The primary route has three planned national-park days: compare €15 in day tickets with the €13.50 annual pass, and confirm whether each gate charges separately.

days.drive: TIV → M-11 → Lepetane ferry → Kamenari → M-1 via Herceg Novi / Lipci / Risan → Kotor · scenic loop allow 1.5–2 h; direct road 20–30 min
days.morning: Land at TIV at 13:50. Collect the estate car, test-load both checked cases and both cabin trolleys under the closed parcel shelf, photograph existing damage, and get the roadside number before you leave. Plan wheels rolling around 15:15–15:30.
days.afternoon: Go straight to your Kotor hotel without stopping on the way. For the scenic bay loop, take M-11 from Tivat to Lepetane, cross to Kamenari, then follow M-1 west via Herceg Novi and Lipci before continuing around the north shore through Risan to Kotor. The published summer timetable runs every 15–20 minutes through Oct 11; the Oct small-car fare is €4 off-season. This is the long scenic way, not a shortcut; use the direct Tivat–Kotor road through the Vrmac tunnel if you just want to get to the hotel. Stay with the car at the ferry and do not stop for a viewpoint or swim until all four bags are unloaded.
days.evening: Once the bags are inside, walk Kotor Old Town for dinner. Skip the car trip into the old center: traffic pinches down and parking is the trap. If you arrive late, eat near the hotel and save the walls for another day.
days.parking: Go straight to the Kotor lodging and unload. For any Old Town stop, walk from hotel or signed edge parking.
days.cash: Keep €4 ready if you take the ferry; Oct 1–6 uses the published off-season fare.
days.heading: Day 1 - Tivat → Kotor / Bay ferry option / Old Town

days.drive: Local Kotor / Perast · allow ≤2 h total
days.morning: Start with Kotor Old Town before the day-trippers fill the lanes. If you want the walls, start early, check October opening hours and ticket price, and wear shoes with grip; wet stone steps are slick.
days.afternoon: Drive to Perast and use the signed parking area rather than squeezing onto the waterfront road. Walk the old lanes and take the Our Lady of the Rocks boat only after confirming the skipper is operating and the sea is calm. Be back in Kotor by 16:00.
days.evening: Dinner in Kotor; book a table if you want a quiet waterfront seat. Leave the car parked for the evening.
days.parking: Park outside the Old Town or use your hotel space. In Perast, leave the car in the signed lot and walk down.
days.cash: Carry small notes for the walls and boat; the traveler fares in the old notes are not current prices.
stops: Our Lady of the Rocks pier
days.heading: Day 2 - Kotor / Old Town / Perast

days.drive: Kotor ↔ Lovćen ↔ Cetinje · plan 2.5 h adjusted
days.morning: Leave Kotor around 08:00 and climb the Kotor serpentine toward Lovćen. The hairpins are tight and buses need space; use a low gear downhill and stop only at proper pullouts. Turn around if fog closes the views.
days.afternoon: Park at the signed Lovćen visitor area, then choose the short Ivanova Korita walk or the mausoleum stairs. Do not treat 460 steps as a casual stop. Continue to Cetinje only if the return drive still ends before dark; skip the extra town if the weather or traffic is slow.
days.evening: Return to Kotor for dinner. The coast fallback exists so you can make a sound call if the high roads are wet or foggy.
days.parking: Use signed Lovćen parking. Leave all luggage at Kotor; do not park on the serpentine for photos.
days.cash: Carry cash for park entry and small village purchases; confirm current prices at the gate.
days.heading: Day 3 - Kotor → Lovćen → Cetinje / mountain fallback

days.drive: Kotor ↔ Virpazar · 2 h 53 adjusted round trip
days.morning: Leave around 08:00 for Virpazar. For the scenic line, climb R-1 toward Njeguši and Cetinje, then use R-15. For the simpler coastal line, take M-1 via Budva and Petrovac, then M-1.1 through Sozina and M-2/R-15 to Virpazar; Sozina is tolled. Follow live routing if roadworks or weather change the choice. Do not assume a boat is running in October.
days.afternoon: Park at the signed village lot. Book the boat only after confirming the operator, lake conditions, fare and return time. The park currently lists €5/person/day and one cruise included; check the inclusion before paying twice. Be ashore by 15:45. If boats stop for the season, use the village and a reserved winery instead.
days.evening: Return to Kotor before dusk. Keep the evening easy; do not add another coastal town on the drive back.
days.parking: Use the signed Virpazar car park. Bags stay at your Kotor hotel; the pier and village are walkable.
days.cash: Confirm the boat price and ticket inclusion before boarding; old traveler prices are only historical.
days.heading: Day 4 - Kotor → Virpazar / Lake Skadar

days.morning: Sleep in and book a spa treatment in Tivat only after confirming that non-guests can use the facilities and getting the full price in writing. Do not assume hotel day access is available.
days.afternoon: Drive to Tivat for the appointment, then return to Kotor by 15:30. If the spa is unavailable or overpriced, skip it: take a short bay walk or revisit the Old Town instead. Keep luggage at the hotel.
days.evening: Reserve a final Kotor dinner and walk the waterfront. Pack tonight so the morning airport transfer stays simple.
days.parking: Leave the car at the spa or marked Tivat parking; keep all luggage at Kotor.
days.cash: Ask for the day access/treatment total and payment method before booking.
days.heading: Day 5 - Kotor / Tivat spa / Bay-side finish

days.morning: Have breakfast at 08:30 and leave Kotor by 09:30. Take the direct road to TIV; do not detour for a last viewpoint. Refuel only if your contract requires it, photograph the fuel gauge and car condition, and return the car by 11:30.
days.afternoon: Walk to the terminal and be inside by 12:15 for the required counter check-in. The flight leaves at 14:55, but rental inspection queues and airport procedures are not the place to gamble.
days.parking: Go straight to TIV. Return the car by 11:30, then walk to the counter.
days.cash: Keep your card and rental paperwork accessible.
days.heading: Day 6 - Kotor → TIV / rental return / flight home

checks.detail: Kotor for all five nights; no hotel moves after airport arrival.

checks.name: Daily adjusted driving ≤5.5 h
checks.detail: Planned maximum is 2 h 53 including the +20% terrain allowance. Check route conditions and actual waypoint times daily.

checks.name: Mountain / boat daylight margin
checks.detail: Lovćen and boat activities are scheduled to finish by 16:00; confirm weather, service and civil twilight on the day.

checks.name: Luggage concealment
checks.detail: All bags are unloaded and secured at the Kotor lodging on Day 1; no transfer days.

checks.name: Day 6 airport radius and terminal by 12:15

checks.name: Tara bridge access
checks.detail: Fallback does not route near the bridge or alpine approaches.

crucialGroundTips: Keep all five nights in Kotor and use one day trip at a time. The Bay is beautiful, but its narrow roads jam quickly; start coastal drives before 08:00 when possible.
Book the rental by exact model and test the four bags under the parcel shelf. Get excess, glass, tires/wheels, underbody, gravel and roadside terms in writing.
Kotor Old Town parking is the bottleneck. Reserve a hotel space or park at a signed lot outside the walls and walk in; do not keep circling the narrow center.
Add 20% to mountain route estimates and 30–60 minutes for traffic or photo stops. Use Google Maps for driving and Maps.me for marked trails; download both before leaving Wi-Fi.

Carry cash for small park booths and boat skippers, but ask the operator what a ticket includes. Historical boat fares are not current prices; never pay for a cruise twice without checking the Skadar ticket inclusion.
Check AMSCG, local weather and operator status that morning. Wet rock, fog and narrow unguarded edges are enough reason to cancel a viewpoint or hike.
Unload luggage at the Kotor lodging before excursions. Keep the car empty and locked while parked.

budget.label: Lodging · 5 nights, two adults
budget.note: Planning range for guarded parking at Kotor x3 nights + Žabljak x2 (primary); fallback is Kotor x5. Not live inventory.

budget.label: Rental · estate/wagon + insurance
budget.note: Five-day planning allowance. Exact midsize estate, low-excess SCDW, glass, tires/wheels, underbody/gravel and roadside cover must be quoted.

budget.label: Fuel + tolls
budget.note: Planning range includes the extra P14 out-and-back mileage and mountain elevation gains. Ferry is €4 each way for a small passenger car in Oct (off-season); routes do not require Sozina or the A1. Fuel rates and ferry tariffs should be rechecked shortly before travel.

budget.label: Parks + boat + walls + spa
budget.note: Planning allowance for two-person admissions, Kotor walls and optional spa. Durmitor and Skadar list €5/person/day; Skadar lists one cruise included. For the primary route, three planned park days total €15/person versus €13.50/person for the 2026 all-parks annual pass, if separate admission is charged each day. Fallback plans two park days (€10/person), so the annual pass costs more. Confirm ticket terms and October operations.

budget.label: Food & drink
budget.note: €90–150 per couple per day, including one winery/local tasting allowance.

budget.label: Contingency cash
budget.note: Carry €100–150 in small cash notes; reserve total also covers weather reroutes, fuel and unplanned fees.
